instances.claim: This tells me that the value is decoupled from the object, continually redefined by collective consensus — three times, in the same abstract register, with no new level of operation added.
instances.why: Line 16 states the point (value leaves the object and becomes a vessel for social consensus); 17 says the same thing with 'indeterminate and continually redefined' — a paraphrase that also repeats the 'continually redefined by decentralized consensus' already delivered in 15; 18 says it a third time as 'an ongoing process of redefinition.' All three sit at the level of the concept — none moves to the object, the viewer, or the form, which 19 and 20 then do. Keep 16, the only one that names the mechanism; 17 and 18 cost running time without adding a register.
